小林陸上総隊司令官は、小泉防衛大臣・テオドロ国防大臣とともに、フィリピンのイロコス・ノルテ州ラオアグにおいて、第１特科団が実施した、同国初となる８８式地対艦誘導弾の実弾射撃を視察しました。

射撃の状況に加え、米海兵隊のネメシス（無人地対艦ミサイル）も視察し日米の連携強化について意見交換を行いました。

陸上総隊は日米比の協力を通じ、地域の平和と安定に貢献していきます。✨

#バリカタン　#肩を並べて　#BK26 #Balikatan　#ShoulderToshoulder

The Lieutenant General Kobayashi, Commanding General of the Grand Component Command(GCC), together with Minister of Defense Koizumi and the Minister of Defense Teodoro, observed the first live-fire exercise of Japan’s Type 88 Surface-to Ship Missile conducted by the 1st Artillery Brigade in Laoag, Ilocos Norte, Philippines.

They also observed the U.S. Marine Corps’ NMESIS, and exchanged views on strengthening Japan-U.S. cooperation.

Through cooperation among Japan, the U.S., and the Philippines, the GCC will continue contributing to regional peace and stability.

陸上総隊は、平素から運用に係る事項に関し方面隊等を総括します。また、陸上総隊司令部は、統合作戦司令部の指揮を受け、自衛艦隊司令部、航空総隊司令部等及び米軍との間における平素からの運用に係る調整を一元的に実施します。
　これにより、迅速かつ円滑な部隊運用及び調整が可能となるため、統合運用の実効性が向上します。

data.text:
Isa ang Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) sa mga ahensiya na kinilala ng Department of Education (DepEd) sa ginanap na Partners' Appreciation Program ngayong araw sa Mandaluyong City. 

Nakibahagi si MMDA Chairman Atty. Don Artes sa seremonya sa temang "Partnerships that endure. Reforms that last." 

Sa pangunguna ni Education Secretary Sonny Angara, pinasalamatan niya ang ang mga tapat at matagal nang katuwang ng DepEd na tumutulong sa pagtataguyod ng de-kalidad na edukasyon sa Pilipinas. Nagsilbi namang panauhing pandangal si Mandaluyong City Mayor Menchie Abalos sa aktibidad.

Taon-taon, katuwang ng DepEd ang MMDA sa Oplan Balik Eskwela kung saan sinisimulan ang paglilinis at pag-aayos ng mga paaralan bilang paghahanda sa pagbubukas ng klase; pag-deploy ng mga traffic personnel sa mga pangunahing lansangan malapit sa mga paaralan o school zones; pagpapanatili ng disiplina sa kalsada at pagtiyak sa kaligtasan ng mga mag-aaral na tumatawid o naglalakad malapit sa mga paaralan; at pagpapalaganap ng mahahalagang impormasyon at anunsyo mula sa kagawaran. 
 #mmda #mmdaatyourservice

LOOK: Participants of the “Imperialist Crisis and War: A People’s Alternative Forum to the ASEAN Summit 2026” marched in front of the University of the Philippines Cebu on Friday, May 8, following the conclusion of the forum.

Students, labor groups, and various progressive organizations gathered to voice opposition to imperialism, militarization, and policies they say continue to affect ordinary Filipinos amid the ASEAN Summit activities. via Chinky O.
